templates.name: 强化学习的状态动作奖励

templates.name: 实验因子与处理组合

templates.name: 数据采集与评价计划

templates.name: 研究任务与阶段交付

pptxVisual.reviewMethod: All eight actual-PPTX contact sheets were inspected. After the final semantic correction, pages 3 and 15 were inspected again at original resolution; the other 46 page PNGs matched the previously reviewed render byte for byte. Page 48 was also checked again at original resolution.
findings: No clipping or overlapping content was observed in the inspected render.
The train/validation/test diagram uses three branches from one independent-unit split.
Page 3 uses the neutral label 验证与比较.
The reference list and right-hand notes remain visually separated.
pptxVisual.scope: Visual review covers the supplied layout fixtures and rendered objects. Synthetic template values are not research findings; bibliographic placeholders are not verified papers.
